capabilities.description: What the channel's surface can render. The AI Agent tailors replies to the declared capabilities. Omitted fields default to false. Read-only on native channels, whose capabilities are fixed by the surface.

metadata.description:
A dictionary of key, value pairs assigned to the channel. Metadata may not exceed 4KB total.
- `metadata` keys may only be of type: `string`
- `metadata` values may only be one of type: `string`, `boolean`, `integer`, or `number` (float)

created_at.description: The date and time the channel was created

markdown.description: Preserve Markdown (bold, italic, and links) in replies instead of flattening to plain text.
